decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line builds directly on the firm's core natural skincare formulation know-how and has had its own page in both years, so the firm can interpret results and refine it, which makes it likely to stay.

The hyaluronic acid serum is close to the firm's established facial care competence and stayed listed in both years, so in-house development capability supports keeping it, although its lower visibility adds some risk.

The cleansing oil was launched only recently and relies on the firm's oil-based natural formulation knowledge, so it is likely to be kept and evaluated, even though the earlier withdrawal of the cleansing milk shows that cleansing products can be pruned.
